blurb: Boom Karaoke is a fully licensed karaoke bar located in downtown Toronto, offering over 150,000 songs in various languages. Guests can enjoy private karaoke rooms with hourly rates and a wide range of cocktails, beers, and bottle service. The venue is conveniently located one block from Wellesley Subway Station with nearby public parking.
